scientific_limitations_and_integrity: Classical two-mass unpinned Hooke dimer only, independent Markovian Gaussian thermostats, positive masses/frictions/temperatures and stationary relative process. The center-of-mass position has no stationary law. The theorem maximizes steady expected heat current, not finite-time transport, fluctuations, or pinned/quantum variants. Priority assessment checked directly relevant original full text where available; Barton (2015) and Zürcher–Talkner (1990) full texts remained inaccessible, so historical priority is not independently certified. No authorship or independent external validation is claimed.
title: A sharp universal asymmetry ceiling for optimal thermal contacts in an unequal-mass Langevin dimer
